category.label: EEG
category.description: Non-invasive scalp electroencephalography. Records aggregate cortical field potentials on the order of microvolts, sampled at 250–2000 Hz across 8–256 channels.

parameters.name: Sampling rate
parameters.notes: ≥ 250 Hz for standard EEG; ≥ 1000 Hz for HFOs.

parameters.name: Alpha band power
parameters.notes: Posterior dominant rhythm at rest, eyes closed.

parameters.name: Theta band power
parameters.notes: Frontal midline theta with cognitive control.

parameters.name: Gamma band power
parameters.notes: Highly contaminated by EMG; report artifact rejection.

pitfalls.mitigation: ICA + strict channel rejection; report retained variance
Report reference (avg, mastoid, REST); repeat with 2nd scheme

references.title: IFCN standards for digital recording of clinical EEG
EEGNet: A Compact Convolutional Network for EEG-based BCIs
